package decode

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/types"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestRepair37DecoderConsumer(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("REPAIR37_LOGS"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var observations []struct {
		Name string
		Log  types.Log
		Args map[string]any
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &observations); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(observations) != 12 {
		t.Fatalf("native logs = %d", len(observations))
	}
	decoder := NewDecoder()
	for _, o := range observations {
		if o.Log.Address != common.HexToAddress("0x1017") {
			t.Fatalf("wrong producer %s", o.Log.Address)
		}
		got, err := decoder.Decode(o.Log)
		if err != nil || got == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s decode = %+v, %v", o.Name, got, err)
		}
		// JSON normalizes small numeric widths in the same way as this transported expectation.
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(got.Args)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var args map[string]any
		if err = json.Unmarshal(encoded, &args); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if got.EventName != o.Name || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, o.Args) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: decoded %+v, want %+v", o.Name, args, o.Args)
		}
		malformed := o.Log
		malformed.Data = malformed.Data[:31]
		if _, err := decoder.Decode(malformed); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s accepted truncated data", o.Name)
		}
	}
	unknown := observations[0].Log
	unknown.Topics = []common.Hash{common.HexToHash("0xdeadbeef")}
	if got, err := decoder.Decode(unknown); got != nil || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unknown topic = %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
}
